interface.shortDescription: On-brand images, video & prototypes on the best models
interface.longDescription: Northlit is the AI design suite: the best image and video models (GPT Image 2.5, Gemini, FLUX.2, Seedance, Kling, Veo), your brand context, and your marketing intelligence orchestrated in one platform. Explore a brief as a board of divergent direction mocks, generate on-brand images and video, build any direction into a working HTML prototype and publish it — then edit the results with real tools: Studio layers, erase and retext, 4K upscales, a video timeline with captions, voiceover and music. Everything generates under your Brand DNA and lands on your own Northlit canvases. Boards and images render inline; click any card to view it full size.
